name: Seinyuu no Miko Onee-chan Ruri ~Iyashi no Bonyuu de Nakadashi Seikatsu~
original_name: 聖乳の巫女お姉ちゃん瑠璃 ～癒しの母乳で中出し生活～
source:
The lead character has a childhood friend who has become a shrine maiden.
One day, he is put to the test to marry her and receives a curse of death.
It turns out that only her milk has the power to cancel it.
And this is how his love life with her, healed by her breasts and milk.

translation:
主人公有一名成为巫女的青梅竹马。
一天，他为了与她结婚而接受考验，却中了死亡诅咒。
原来，只有她的乳汁拥有解除诅咒的力量。
就这样，一段由她的胸部与乳汁带来治愈的恋爱生活开始了。
